title: Systematize Playground Dev Ports
description: Playground dev ports are inconsistent and overlap (e.g. cad play vs dag play, runViteBunxDev port bumping steals reserved ports). Centralize port registry, use fixed strict ports per playground, align launch.json/project.json/scripts/validate probes.
summary: Added `ui/styling/playground-dev-ports.ts` as the single source of truth for all playground dev/test ports and env vars (cad=6020, dag=6017, flow=6016, puzzles 6012–6014, etc.). Play scripts now use `fixedPort: true` so `runViteBunxDev` never bumps into another playground's reserved port. Tightened flow/dag launch.json serverReadyAction patterns to exact ports. Validate probes and puzzle 3d playwright default now use canonical test ports. Tests: repo/lib/js playground + resolveDevPort (7/7 pass).
